summary: Elevra Lithium Ltd furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of an ASX continuous-disclosure filing) carrying three ASX exhibits: an Appendix 3G notification of 132,928 ordinary shares issued on 4 November 2026 on exercise of employee performance rights (ELVAM) between 2 and 4 November 2026, an Appendix 3H cessation of securities, and a corporate presentation. No transaction, stake, price, premium or board recommendation is disclosed. The issuance is a routine employee-incentive conversion already quoted on ASX; no special-situation or risk-arb angle arises, with only minor dilution and overhang considerations.
